prepare_subject_encoder: prepare a SubjectEncoder by calling prepare with a list of events to build the label-to-index mapping
encode_events_to_tensor: call the SubjectEncoder on events with a start time and duration to get a torch tensor encoding
get_static_embedding: get a static torch tensor embedding for a single event using the SubjectEncoder get_static method
extract_subject_field: extract the subject field from an event using the SubjectEncoder _extract_event_field method
generate_timed_arrays: generate TimedArray objects from a list of events using the SubjectEncoder _get_timed_arrays method
